# Northflank

The self-service developer platform that automates and unifies deployment of any workload, on any cloud, at any scale.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/northflank/.

## Actions

- **Create or Update Project**: Create a new project or update an existing project in Northflank (upsert operation).
- **Create or Update Secret**: Create or update a secret group in a Northflank project.
- **Create Project**: Create a new project in Northflank.
- **Create Secret**: Create a secret group in a Northflank project.
- **Get Project** (read-only): Retrieve detailed information about a specific Northflank project.
- **Get Secret** (read-only): Retrieve a secret from a Northflank project including its contents.
- **List Projects** (read-only): List all projects in your Northflank team with pagination support.
- **List Secrets** (read-only): List all secrets belonging to a Northflank project.
- **List Services** (read-only): List all services belonging to a Northflank project.
- **Update Project**: Update a project in Northflank.
- **Update Secret**: Update a secret in a Northflank project.
- **Delete Project**: Permanently delete a Northflank project and all associated resources.
- **Get DNS ID** (read-only): Retrieve the DNS identifier for the authenticated account.
- **Get Secret Details** (read-only): View a secret with details about its linked addons from a Northflank project.
- **List Addon Types** (read-only): Retrieve information about available addon types in Northflank.
- **List Cloud Provider Node Types** (read-only): Retrieve supported cloud provider node types available on Northflank.
- **List Cloud Provider Regions** (read-only): Retrieve supported cloud provider regions available on Northflank.
- **List Pipelines** (read-only): List all pipelines for a Northflank project.
- **List Plans** (read-only): Retrieve available billing/resource plans in Northflank.
- **List Regions** (read-only): Retrieve available project regions in Northflank.
- **Patch Secret**: Partially update a secret group in a Northflank project.
